items.title_en: How An Enslaved Woman Named La Malinche Helped Hernán Cortés Topple The Aztec Empire

items.summary_en: Roberto Cueva del Rio/Wikimedia Commons A 20th-century painting of La Malinche and Hernán Cortés speaking with Mesoamerican leaders. La Malinche — also known as Malintzin and Doña Marina — was a Mesoamerican woman who served as a trusted advisor and interpreter to Spanish conquistador Hernán Cortés in the 16th century.
